title: Setback to a communal street: no provision in Table 3.3a
text: C3.3.1 Buildings are set back from the street boundary in accordance with Table 3.3a.

replaces.note: 'adjoining communal street 0.5 m' row (R30-R60) not carried
R10-R25 communal street treated as a secondary street (Table B legend, 5.1.2 C2.1(iv))

verified.note: Confirmed missing: Table 3.3a (p29) has rows for primary street, secondary street and the two laneway or right-of-way rows only; Table 4A (p7) has none either. Figure 3.3d (p31) still shows a '2.5m communal street setback (clause 5.1.2 C2.1 iv)' and a '1.5m communal street setback (Table B column 7 secondary street)'. No value on the page.

notes: from: ch3 C3.3.1#communal-street. As in Chapter 3, Table 3.3a (p29) and Table 4A (p7) have no communal street row, although the Table of Changes says communal street setbacks are reduced, Figure 3.3d (p31) still shows a 2.5 m communal street setback citing Part B clause 5.1.2 C2.1 iv, and C1.2.3 and C3.7.13-C3.7.14 refer to communal streets (C4P1-077). A building fronting an internal communal street could need the secondary street value (1.5 m / 1 m) or the 0.5 m right-of-way value; a planner decides. No value encoded; building.communal_street_setback_m is recorded for the planner.
